culprit_citations.quoted_text: Champions Fing Inc | Fair Value 9,886 | % of Net Assets 1.0

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the extracted investment fair value total of USD 1,694.770 million agrees exactly with both the filing schedule total (table 13 row 55) and the balance-sheet investment total (table 6 row 7). The filing reports net assets of USD 1,020.130 million (table 6 row 36). Source position percentages are printed to one decimal: for example, Champions Fing Inc has fair value USD 9.886 million, which is 0.9691% of net assets and correctly rounds to the disclosed 1.0% (table 10 row 6). The 13.08% violation rate therefore reflects a check that does not accommodate source display rounding, not erroneous extracted values.
